ui.build.title: Build
ui.build.close.tip: Close the build menu (B or Esc)
ui.build.pick.tip: Select to place. Keys 1-9 pick from this tab while the menu is open.
ui.build.locked.tip: Locked. Focus shows what unlocks it.
ui.build.demolish.name: Demolish
ui.build.demolish.desc: Remove a building or road tiles. A finished building refunds half its cost.
ui.build.demolish.tip: Demolish tool. There is no gamepad hotkey; this entry is the gamepad's way in.
ui.build.menu.tip: Build menu (B). LB and RB switch tabs, the d-pad moves, A selects.
